title: Never Paste These 3 Things Into AI
style: Read this like a calm, trustworthy teacher giving an important safety tip in a quick social video. Clear, serious but friendly.

segments.title: Never paste these 3 things into AI
segments.say: Using ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini? Never paste these three things.

segments.title: Stop before you paste
bullets: 2. Card, bank or Social Security numbers
segments.say: One: passwords and login codes. Two: card numbers, bank numbers or Social Security numbers. Three: your customers' private information, like their address, phone number or order history.

segments.title: Swap in placeholders
bullets: Legal, tax or medical? Ask a professional
segments.say: Instead, use placeholders, like customer name in brackets. Always double check facts and numbers. And for legal, tax or medical decisions, ask a professional.

chat.user: Write a thank-you note to [CUSTOMER NAME] for order [ORDER #]. Warm, 2 sentences.
chat.ai: Hi [CUSTOMER NAME], thank you so much for your order [ORDER #]! We hope you love it, and we're here if you need anything.

segments.title: Like & subscribe to stay safe with AI
bullets: 👍 Like and share with a friend
segments.say: Share this with someone who just started using AI. Like and subscribe to Run It With AI for more simple, safe lessons.
